description: This Dart source file defines the ExpenseRepository class, providing CRUD operations and query methods for managing Expense entities in a SQLite database within a Flutter application.

classes.name: ExpenseRepository
classes.description: A repository class that encapsulates CRUD operations and filtered queries for Expense entities stored in SQLite.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts an Expense object into the 'expenses' table, replacing existing entries on conflict.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Expense record identified by its id.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an Expense record by its id.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches an Expense by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Expense records, optionally filtered by category, date range, or search query.

methods.name: sumByCategory
methods.description: Calculates the sum of amounts grouped by category within an optional date range.

methods.name: totalAmount
methods.description: Calculates the total sum of expenses within an optional date range.
